seq.description: Per stream per device: the same on every transport.

epoch.description: Boot counter, incremented on every boot.

ts.description: Unix seconds, null while the device clock is not set.

usig_boot.description: Signed events (AUTHORITY.md section 3.4): the boot epoch the signature counts in.

usig_seq.description: One counter for every signed message of this boot, across all streams.

usig.description: Base64 Ed25519 by the node key over the object without this member; always the last member.

unsigned.description: Present instead of the three above when the device cannot sign.
